in_marathi.name: Bodhi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bodhi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘bodh’, meaning ‘to awaken’, ‘enlightened’, or ‘knowledge’. In Hinduism, Bodhi is associated with the enlightenment of Buddha. The tree under which Buddha gained enlightenment is called the Bodhi tree.
